title: fix(plugin-view): the New button opens a create form under a split or popover navigation (objectui#10975)
body:
Fixes #10975
Clause-②: no

Under a `split` or `popover` navigation mode, `ObjectView`'s New button now opens a create form. Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 2 dispatch (PM claim `5874519919`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`: a `renderCreateSurface` helper draws the create form on the drawer or the modal when `formMode` is `create`. The `split` branch renders it, and so does the default branch when `formLayout` is `popover`.
  - `formLayout`, `handleCreate`, `handleEdit`, `handleRowClick` and both `NavigationOverlay` branches are unchanged. A record opened to view or edit still opens beside the list under `split`, and in the popover under `popover`.
  - The fix covers both sources of the mode: the node's own `navigation`, and the active named view's (read first since PR objectui#10967).
- New pin file `ObjectView.splitPopoverCreate-10975.test.tsx`: 3 fix rows and 3 controls.
- New changeset `.changeset/10975-split-popover-create-surface.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-view': patch`.
- Dated note appended to the pending `.changeset/10885-object-view-route2-named-view-rest.md`, in the objectui#10533 form. Its sentence "the New button opens no form" is now false.
  - The front matter is byte-identical: the sha1 of its first three lines is equal at base and head. The diff is 3 added lines and 0 removed.
- `packages/plugin-view/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, the same two edits in each:
  - "Opening a record" gains one sentence: under `split` or `popover` the create form opens on the `layout` surface.
  - In "On the registered renderer", the sentence saying the create form's surface follows the named view gets the `split` / `popover` exception.

## The chosen surface and why

The create form opens where the node's own non-split create path would open it. That is the surface `formLayout` falls back to with no `navigation`: `layout`, meaning `schema.layout`, or `deriveRecordSurface` when it is unset.
- `layout: 'modal'`: the modal (`renderModalForm`).
- `layout: 'drawer'`: the drawer (`renderDrawerForm`).
- `layout: 'page'` with `onNavigate`: the form is never reached. `handleCreate` hands `onNavigate('new', 'edit')` to the router first, as before.
- `layout: 'page'` without `onNavigate`: here the code has no single answer, because the non-split path has no surface for a page inside this component either. This case takes the drawer: it is what `deriveRecordSurface` answers for a light desktop object, and it is the registered renderer's `defaultProps.layout`.

A named view's `navigation` replaces the node's as a whole (objectui#10885 member 4). So under a named `split`, the node's own `navigation` does not choose the create surface; `layout` does. The README's Create section already says "the new-record form opens on the `layout` surface".

**`edit`, decided explicitly: unchanged.** `handleEdit` sets the record, so the split panel and the popover already draw the edit form beside it. The edit control below measures this, green on base and head.

## Pins: red on base, green on head

`ObjectForm` is a sink that shows the mode its schema was built for. The drawer is found by vaul's `data-vaul-drawer` attribute, and the modal by `role="dialog"` with no drawer ancestor.

## Acceptance notes

- **The docs sentence named in the dispatch was not where the dispatch said.** The README and the docs page do not carry "the New button opens no form": 0 hits in both, against 1 hit in the pending changeset as the positive control.
  - What the fix does make false there is "the surface and width of the record, create and edit forms, follow the active named view".
  - Under a named `split` or `popover`, the create form's surface now comes from `layout`, though its width still follows the named `navigation`. That sentence is amended, and "Opening a record" now documents the node's own case.
- **`layout: 'page'` with no `onNavigate`, outside `split` / `popover`:** `formLayout` is `'page'`, which has no render branch, so New opens nothing there either.
  - This is a read-only inference, not measured.
  - No in-tree JSON producer authors `layout: 'page'` without `onNavigate`.
  - Not filed.
- **The README's Create section** says the new-record form opens on the `layout` surface. Under a `drawer` or `modal` navigation it opens on that navigation's surface instead. This wording drift predates the change and is not made false by it.
- **A closed drawer is now mounted at rest under `split`,** because the initial `formMode` is `create`. That keeps the create drawer's exit animation, as on the drawer path. A closed drawer renders nothing into the DOM, and the row-click control is unchanged.
